journal: ACS Advances in Chemistry Series 177 (Thermodynamic Behavior of Electrolytes in Mixed Solvents II), chapter 13, pp. 189-203
experimental_method: Saturation method: known volume of CO2 contacted with a measured amount of gas-free salt solution at 25 C and 1 atm CO2 partial pressure, volume of remaining gas measured, corrected for solution vapour pressure; reported as Ostwald coefficient.
uncertainties_stated: CO2 in pure water average L0 = 0.8264 agreed 'quite well' with literature; correlation of all data with the two-parameter equation within about 0.5 % deviation; no uncertainty on individual values.
quality_remarks: Single-salt x1 = 0.00 and 1.00 blocks in Table I are from Ref. 8 (Yasunishi and Yoshida, in press), not new measurements here. Vapour pressure of mixed-salt solutions was estimated (Robinson-Bower), not measured. Salt concentration checked by chloride titration. Several blocks repeat between Table I and Tables II-IV.

not_extracted_tables.reason: fitted parameters A and B of the empirical equation

table_1.note: 247 = 205 data + 7 system heading rows + 35 block label rows

extraction_notes: Text layer has letter-spaced words but the numbers are clean; every number block was compared with the page images (pages 191-193) and matched. Column assignment of short columns (blocks with fewer rows) was set by hand from the image: Table I NH4Cl+(NH4)2SO4 last row has no x1 = 0.50 entry, NaCl+NH4Cl last row has no x1 = 0.75 entry, NaCl+KNO3 last row only x1 = 0.75 and 1.00; Table II last row only blocks 3 and 4; Table III last row only blocks 1 and 2; Table IV rows 6-7 only block 2. Pure-water Ostwald coefficient L0 = 0.8264 appears only in the text (an average, not tabulated) and is not in the CSVs. Cs unit kmol/m3 comes from the nomenclature and figure axes; table headers show only Cs and L. Cs and L printed with three and four decimals respectively.
